competition.title: The Grand Pitch Season 5
competition.details:
Objective:

The Grand Pitch, the flagship fundraising event of the Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) at Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune (SIBM Pune), provides ambitious startups with a platform to raise capital, gain strategic insights, and accelerate their growth.

Modelled on the high-stakes format of leading investor pitch platforms, The Grand Pitch brings together promising entrepreneurs and a distinguished panel of venture capitalists, angel investors, micro-VCs, industry leaders, and high-net-worth individuals, collectively contributing to an investment pool of up to INR 75 Crores for this edition.

The Grand Pitch aims to create a platform where entrepreneurial vision meets investment opportunity, enabling founders to validate their businesses, strengthen their strategies, and transform potential into scalable success.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Operational Ventures: The startup must be an active, operational venture with a demonstrated business model and, where applicable, revenue traction.
  • Registration: The startup must be officially registered as a legal business entity.
  • Authenticity: All information and documents submitted by the startup must be accurate, authentic, and verifiable. Any misrepresentation of information may result in disqualification.
  • Founder Participation: At least one founder or authorised representative of the venture must be available to participate in the prescribed pitching rounds.
  • Investment Readiness: Startups should have a clearly defined funding requirement and be prepared to discuss their proposed investment terms with prospective investors.

Event Stages

Screening Round

Dates: 17th September 2026 - 29th September 2026

  • Participants will submit a comprehensive pitch deck highlighting their venture, problem statement, solution, market opportunity, business model, traction, financials, and founding team.
  • The pitch deck should clearly communicate the startup’s value proposition, competitive advantage, growth potential, and funding requirements.
  • Submissions will be evaluated based on predefined criteria including market opportunity, innovation, business viability, traction, scalability, financial potential, and strength of the founding team.
  • Any misrepresentation or falsification of information may result in immediate disqualification.

Preliminary Round – Online Pitch Presentation

Dates: 28th September 2026 - 03rd October 2026

  • Shortlisted startups from the Screening Round will present their ventures before the evaluation panel.
  • Founders will be expected to demonstrate their startup’s scalability, differentiation, market potential, traction, and financial viability.
  • The round will enable the evaluation panel to conduct an in-depth assessment of the venture and its potential for investment.
  • Selected startups will advance to the Mentoring Phase and subsequently to the Grand Finale.

Mentorship Phase – Online

Dates: 04th October 2026 - 09th October 2026

  • Finalist startups will undergo a focused mentoring phase with experienced industry experts, entrepreneurs, and investors.
  • Mentors will provide strategic guidance to help founders identify gaps and strengthen their business models.
  • The phase will focus on refining business strategy, financial projections, market positioning, scalability, and investment readiness.
  • Founders will also have the opportunity to incorporate relevant feedback and polish their final pitch ahead of the Grand Finale.

Grand Finale - Offline
Date: 13th October 2026

Venue: SIBM Pune

  • The finalist startups will pitch their ventures before a distinguished panel of investors at the Grand Finale of The Grand Pitch Season 5.
  • Founders will present their final investment propositions and engage directly with investors through a high-stakes pitch and interaction.
  • The Grand Finale will serve as the defining stage of the competition, providing selected ventures with the opportunity to secure funding, strategic partnerships, mentorship, and visibility.

organisation.name: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management (SIBM), Pune
organisation.description:
• Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune, a premier B-School in India, is Constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University).
  • Established in 1978, SIBM Pune is consistently ranked among the top 10 B-Schools of the country.
  • SIBM Pune has been ranked 18th amongst all the B-Schools in India by National Institute Ranking Framework (NIRF), Government of India in 2018.
  • The institute was also awarded 'Gold' Star by the QS Star University Rating 2018.
  • The essential strong pillars of SIBM Pune are its illustrious alumni, exemplary students, full-time faculty and numerous visiting faculty members from the corporate and industry.
  • SIBM Pune is a student-driven institute, with MBA candidates encouraged to participate in the decision-making process that shapes their future as well as that of the Institute.
